h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Tripura

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Tripura

c: FunPlay Systems makes outdoor gym equipment for parks, schools, colleges and housing areas in Tripura. Our machines use the person's own body weight and need no electricity, so they suit public spaces open from dawn. Our Fun Fitness machines are manufactured at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, and travel to Tripura by road through Assam. Our own installation team or a local dealer then fixes them, grouted into concrete or self-standing on a prepared base.

Agartala is where most open gyms in the state get planned, in city parks run by the municipal corporation, in school and college grounds and beside lakes and walking paths. District towns such as Udaipur and Dharmanagar have school grounds and public parks that suit a smaller set of stations. Send us the size of your site and a few photos, and we will suggest machines and draw a layout with clear space around each one. Housing colonies on the edge of Agartala ask for gentler machines for older residents.

richText.heading: Planning for a humid, rainy state

c: Tripura is warm and humid for much of the year, with heavy rain through the monsoon. Low-lying parks can hold water after a storm, so raise the gym area and slope it towards a drain. Our frames are galvanised and the seats and grips are roto-moulded, so they stand up to damp air. Trees help with shade, but keep falling branches and leaves away from moving parts.

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Do you install outdoor gym equipment outside Agartala?
items.a: Yes. We deliver by road to district towns across Tripura, and installation is handled by our team or a dealer in the region. Share the town and site photos to get started.

items.q: How much clear space does a Pendulum machine need?
items.a: Swinging machines need more room than fixed ones, front and back. Our layout drawing marks the exact clear area for each station on your site before you confirm the order.

Manufacturing defects, for 3 years on galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts and 1 year on springs, bearings and spare parts, provided the machines are installed and maintained as per our instructions.
